environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet with NAT gateway. PostgreSQL RDS instance with database user 'app_service' having full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables. No SSRF protection at network level. IMDSv1 enabled on underlying infrastructure. The service handles webhook callbacks from external partners and the callback_url parameter is user-controlled.

config.database_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
config.network: Private subnet with NAT, no egress filtering
